name: Eastern beebalm
desc: Eastern beebalm (Monarda bradburiana): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 26 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Monarda bradburiana, the eastern beebalm or Bradbury's beebalm, is a species of perennial flowering plant in the mint family, Lamiaceae, that is native to much of the southeastern United States.
